final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT c.district_id AS branch_district_id, d.A3 AS region_name, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, d.A3), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_clients FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.branch_district_id, s1.region_name, s1.client_count, 1.0 * s1.client_count / s2.total_clients AS share FROM step1 AS s1 CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2 WHERE s2.total_clients IS NOT NULL) SELECT region_name, AVG(client_count), AVG(share) FROM step3 GROUP BY region_name
